name: Copernicus GFM Daily Observed Flood Extent

source.name: Copernicus Global Flood Monitoring (GFM) STAC catalogue
source.license: Copernicus data and information policy; see GFM terms and conditions
source.provider: European Commission Joint Research Centre / EODC / Copernicus Emergency Management Service
source.limitations: The source has 20 m pixels and observes locations only during Sentinel-1 overpasses; nodata means no frame covered the pixel that UTC day, not no flood, and brief floods between overpasses can be missed. SAR flood mapping under-detects in urban areas, dense vegetation, and steep terrain.

description: Ingests one daily UTC composite of Sentinel-1-derived observed flood extent for the deployment area, initially backfilling the most recent 12 months and then checking daily for completed observation days; COG overviews use flood-preserving max pooling.

destinations.name: Daily observed flood extent
destinations.description: Daily UTC composites of Sentinel-1 flood observations, with flood taking precedence across frames and max-pooled COG overviews preserving sparse flood pixels at small scales.
